g.text: Two sharding keys: posts by author_id, feed_items by user_id
post_id -> (feed_items references posts, cross-shard by design)
posts sharded by author_id -- keeps one author's posts together for PullMerge's hot query.
feed_items sharded by user_id -- keeps one reader's precomputed feed together for GET /feed.
Different hot queries, different shard keys -- forcing one key onto both would scatter the other's reads.
